claim: BP is per-iteration LAUNCH-BOUND; the fused Triton kernel wins by collapsing hundreds of torch scatter/reduce launches to ~2 coalesced FP32 launches/iter. Min-sum is a min/sum semiring -- no GEMM/tensor-core path (forecloses 'why not cuBLAS').

launches_per_iteration.note: launch = a profiler event with positive CUDA self-time; the torch iteration is many scatter_add/gather/reduce kernels, the Triton iteration is 2 fused kernels (check-update + bit-update).

overhead_vs_runtime_ms_per_iter.note: These per-iteration wrappers include run_iterations_batch's host-side syndrome marshalling; the comparison that matters is torch dispatch vs runtime ~ O(1) => launch-bound.

arithmetic_intensity.note: flops/byte << 1 => memory-bandwidth-bound, NOT compute-bound; consistent with a fused-launch min/sum kernel rather than a GEMM.

verdict.summary: torch fires 110 CUDA launches/iter vs Triton 24 (fusion ~4.58x); torch host-dispatch/GPU-runtime ~ 1.00 (launch-bound); no GEMM/tensor-core ops in either profile; arithmetic intensity 0.1667 flop/byte (<1) => the win is fusion + bandwidth, not tensor cores.
